node.statement: Combine the preceding bounds. For e also satisfying C_ca e<=1/2, |alpha-1|<=|alpha-||u_Q|||+|||u_Q||-1|<=C_col e||u_Q||+C_ca e<=(3C_col/2+C_ca)e. Thus A=2C_col+C_ca works. By the canonical normalization in def-canonical-corner-identifications, q_0=alpha^{-1}u_Q; absolute homogeneity of the Hilbert norm gives q_Q(q_0)=1. Taking e_0 as the minimum of the positive thresholds just used proves node 1.1 with universal A,e_0.
